name: dvyukov/go-fuzz
description: Coverage-guided fuzzing solution for Go packages that handles complex text and binary inputs, developed by Dmitry Vyukov (author of syzkaller), predating Go's built-in fuzzing support.
score_rationale: Solid fuzzing tool for Go with 4.8k stars, though activity has slowed since Go added native fuzzing; last commit September 2024.
